decisive_items: reddish-brown annular plaque with peripheral ecchymosis
Perls Prussian blue staining showed prominent hemosiderin deposits
response.rationale: Clinical annular plaque with ecchymotic border, promontory signs, hemosiderin deposits, and absence of atypia or HHV-8 favor targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma over other vascular tumors.

rejected.why: HHV-8 negative and bland endothelial cells exclude Kaposi's sarcoma.
Hemangioma is too nonspecific; lacks the characteristic targetoid hemosiderotic features.
No cellular pleomorphism or mitotic figures argues against angiosarcoma.
No chronic lymphedema context; clinical and histology fit a benign vascular lesion better.
Hobnail hemangioma typically lacks prominent hemosiderin and annular ecchymotic border described.
